title: Multi-Asset Crypto WFA: ETHUSDT Volatility Strategy
objective: Expand crypto strategy coverage by fetching ETHUSDT data and running comparative WFA between BTC and ETH using the ATR breakout strategy. This establishes multi-asset capability in the factory.
hypothesis: The ATR breakout strategy will show different performance characteristics on ETH vs BTC due to ETH's higher volatility and different market dynamics. ETH will likely show higher return potential but also higher drawdowns.
dataset_requirements: ETHUSDT 1h OHLCV data from Binance (500+ candles)
implementation_steps: 1. Use existing binance_fetcher to fetch ETHUSDT 1h data (or create CSV manually if API unavailable)
3. Run WFA with ATR breakout strategy on ETHUSDT data
4. Run WFA with ATR breakout strategy on BTCUSDT data (baseline)
5. Generate comparison report: returns, Sharpe, drawdown, win rate for both assets
6. Create multi-asset summary showing which asset performed better
commands: cd /mnt/c/Users/הלל/Desktop/algo/projects/trading-research-factory && python3 -c "from workspace.data.fetchers.binance_fetcher import fetch_ohlcv; df = fetch_ohlcv('ETHUSDT', '1h', 500); print(f'Fetched {len(df)} candles')"

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA completes successfully for both ETH and BTC with ATR strategy
metrics: ETH: Total return, Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, trade count
BTC: Total return, Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, trade count
Comparison: Return ratio, Sharpe ratio, volatility comparison

fallback_if_blocked: Binance API rate limits - wait and retry or use manual CSV creation
Insufficient ETH data - reduce train/test window or use shorter history
WFA engine error - fallback to single train/test split
notes: This establishes multi-asset capability in the factory
ETH typically has higher volatility than BTC - good test case for ATR strategy
If successful, establishes template for adding SOL and other crypto pairs
Next experiment could add cross-asset strategy (BTC-ETH momentum spread)
